Video generated for topic: Hook:

“She didn’t think the headache meant danger.”

Body:

It started small.

Just headaches.

Then swelling.

Then blurry vision.

People around her said:
“It’s normal during pregnancy.”

But her blood pressure kept rising.

Quietly.

That’s how pre-eclampsia can begin.

Not always with pain.

Sometimes with signs people ignore.

Tracking your blood pressure daily can help catch problems early.

That’s why MaternAlert exists.

CTA:

Know the signs early.

Caption:

Some pregnancy warning signs look harmless at first. 🤰🏾
